abstract: A study on the experimentally induced yolk sac tumor in the rat was made in special regard to the characteristics and origin of tumor cells. Pregnant rats which fetuses were removed on the 12th day of gestation, developed tumors derived from the fetal membranes left outside the uterus, which were composed of differentiated teratomas and yolk sac tumors. Serial observation of the oncogenesis revealed that an early lesion of the yolk sac tumor appeared in a nodule found as early as 3 weeks after the fetectomy and production of alpha-phetoprotein (AFP) was observed histochemically in the tumor cells 5 weeks after the fetectomy. A cultured cell line established after cloning from the transplantable yolk sac tumor which had been induced similarly and converted into ascitic form was also investigated. Light and electron microscopic studies on both induced tumors and the cultured cells indicated a similarity of AFP producing tumor cells with parietal yolk sac cells and of PAS-positive hyaline-like substance with the Reichert membrane. It is reasonable to conclude that the yolk sac tumor observed is regarded as a parietal yolk sac carcinoma described by Pierce. Histogenesis of the tumor is also discussed.
abstract_ja: 腫瘍細胞の特徴と起源に特に着目し、ラットで実験的に誘発された卵黄嚢腫瘍を検討した。妊娠12日目に胎児を摘出した雌ラットでは、子宮外に残された胎児膜由来の腫瘍が生じ、分化した奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍から構成されていた。腫瘍発生の経時的観察により、胎児摘出の3週間後という早期に卵黄嚢腫瘍の初期病変が結節として出現し、5週間後には腫瘍細胞でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生が組織化学的に認められた。同様に誘発され腹水型に変換された移植可能な卵黄嚢腫瘍からクローニングして樹立した培養細胞株も検討した。光学および電子顕微鏡による検討では、誘発腫瘍と培養細胞のいずれにおいても、AFP産生腫瘍細胞は壁側卵黄嚢細胞に類似し、PAS陽性の硝子様物質はライヒェルト膜に類似していた。観察された卵黄嚢腫瘍は、Pierceが記載した壁側卵黄嚢癌と見なすのが妥当と結論される。腫瘍の組織発生についても考察した。
